# Fixed-card flavor–charged-cascade novelty kill test

**7 November 2026 — verdict: NO_GO_CURRENT_PAPER1_CENTER.** Large conditional changes in leptonic daughter branching fractions occur at both saved scalar potentials, but they are generated by selected Yukawa designs whose full flavor and Higgs status is unknown. They demonstrate freedom, not a forced neutrino–cascade correlation or a differentiated, qualified EPJC result. The prior 2017/2021 papers already cover the underlying neutrino/flavor and charged-cascade mechanisms, respectively. The precise combined fixed-card numbers are distinct benchmark arithmetic; novelty of the exact comparison cannot be established from a bounded search.

## Provenance and scope

Read the task, acceptance contract and specified earlier audits. The [comparison](flavor_cascade/LITERATURE_COMPARISON.md) records the dated literature recheck and its limits. The [matrix](flavor_cascade/NOVELTY_WITNESS_MATRIX.json) holds all 16 detailed D12 witnesses, 12 same-target contrasts, 112 family summaries and 24 sensitivity records, and all 64+12 D14 mapped rows. [audit.py](flavor_cascade/audit.py) reads the immutable source records; it recomputes ratios and products, not neutrino solutions, amplitudes or physics validity. The complete listed channel ledger is only on-shell tree two-body; off-shell, finite-width and QCD/EW corrections and physical complete-model totals are not established. No new scan, event generation, cross-card rate transfer or likelihood was performed.

## Exact paired witness test

Each comparison holds the full scalar hash and neutrino target/order fixed; same frozen decay SM/CKM prescription. It changes saved F scale or homogeneous texture and its reconstructed leptonic Yukawas, rather than changing only one matrix entry. No generator is attached to D12. Table entries use the original `central` and `high_F` witnesses; BRs are fractions. `L` is H1→eν+μν+τν, `Z` is H2→H1Z and `B_L=Z×L`.

| Card/order | central → high_F: L | ΔL | Z central → high_F | B_L central → high_F | Γ1, Γ2 ratios |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| D7 NO | 0.00004530 → 0.311719 | +0.311673 | 0.0454771 → 0.0454270 | 0.000002060 → 0.0141604 | 1.45283, 1.00110 |
| D7 IO | 0.00006224 → 0.383567 | +0.383505 | see matrix | see matrix | 1.62214, 1.00151 |
| F13 NO | 0.00011749 → 0.540096 | +0.539978 | 0.485020 → 0.481129 | 0.000056986 → 0.259856 | 2.17411, 1.00809 |
| F13 IO | 0.00016146 → 0.617368 | +0.617206 | see matrix | see matrix | 2.61305, 1.01111 |

The four examples satisfy both prospective tests: |ΔL|≥0.10 and B_L ratio≥2 (ratios 6874, 6153, 4560, 3782). The large ratios partly reflect tiny central denominators; these are not sensitivity metrics. For F13 NO, H1→tb changes 0.997595→0.458852 and B_L/B_tb 0.000117776→1.17706. D7 NO changes 0.996676→0.686025 and 0.00004545→0.45438. The H1 partial leptonic width and total grow substantially; the fixed Z partial width divided by the slightly larger H2 total explains the small drop of Z. Extreme `high_joint` cases grow both H1 and H2 totals substantially (matrix), with even larger L shifts. They have very large retained LFV diagnostic values, which cannot be promoted to physical exclusions or passes because missing amplitudes interfere.

Counterexample to a forced link: F13 NO central→low_joint changes L 0.000117492→0.000117613, Z 0.485020452→0.485020447 and B_tb 0.483853760→0.483853697, while its retained μ→eγ subset falls from 1.785e-12 to 4.031e-20. D7 NO central→low_joint gives L 4.52975e-5→3.19630e-6 and B_tb 0.04532591→0.04532776. These targeted textures cancel direct e–μ entries; F†F is nonzero and full LFV remains unknown. D7 NO and IO `texture_0.0001` ±1% rescalings give retained μ→eγ approximately 1.387e-12 and 3.231–3.232e-12; F13 `texture_0.001` gives 1.732–1.838e-16 and 4.077–4.242e-16. Only the common coefficient scale was perturbed; other complex directions, neutrino nuisances and RG stability were not tested. The texture design, objective and target choices bias these examples. Values are not retention fractions or physical likelihoods.

## D14 matched-family falsification

At each of 16 13-TeV scalar IDs and three 14-TeV IDs the four rows share scalar hash, production receipt and native rate, while family card hashes differ. The observed relative range `(max−min)/min` of BR(H2→H1Z) across families is **0.0005726603%–0.0291025972%** at 13 TeV. The repeated rows are one production integration per scalar/energy, not four independent measurements. At ID 15591, L ranges 0.00013055–0.00031809, tb 0.997454–0.997641, and σ13×Z 3.869369–3.869743 fb. NO L values 0.00013055 and 0.00026944 fall within the IO range 0.00013545–0.00031809 except the slightly smaller endpoint; the ranges overlap. At ID 2264 NO L spans 0.00015119–0.00025657 and IO 0.00017967–0.00030659, also overlapping. These are four selected constructions, not distributions or an ordering likelihood. All daughter flavors and exact σ×BR values are in the matrix. Rates are charge-summed LO 5FS with the native saved rate multiplied once; no 100-TeV rate or unmatched card is inferred. H2→tb and H2→leptons are null for D14 because this CSV has no H2 channel ledger. The known mixing dependence of the off-diagonal Z coupling is in 2021; certificate and historical approximate-B shortlist selection cannot establish causation.

## Hostile-referee novelty matrix

| Large Yukawa-dependent H1 leptonic BR | 2017 §§2.4–2.5, 3–4; 2025 Chen §§II–IV | Fixed Type-II D7/F13 numerical examples differ, but extremes are selected and full LFV unqualified. | INTERESTING_BUT_UNQUALIFIED |
| H2→H1Z→(ℓν)Z conditional topology | 2021 §7, Fig. 9; §8 defers lepton completion | Products reconstructed above; generic cascade already known, no demonstrated viable or discriminating signature. | INTERESTING_BUT_UNQUALIFIED |
| Suppressed direct e–μ texture | 2017 §§3–4, 2023 §§II–V | Low-joint is constructed to cancel entries; F†F and missing mixed-F LFV remain. | INTERESTING_BUT_UNQUALIFIED |
| NO/IO discriminator | 2017 Figs. 8–9 and restricted likelihood | Matched family overlaps and no joint likelihood; selected families cannot establish ordering sensitivity. | NOT_SUPPORTED |
| Tree-vacuum certificate selection | Barroso–Ferreira 2005 Eq. (23); 2021 §4 | Sufficient proof is stronger than a failed numerical search, but no matched selection counterfactual or quantum stability. | ALREADY_DONE_OR_INCREMENTAL |
| 13/14 TeV production ranking | 2021 Figs. 10–14 | Saved rates describe a preselected shortlist; extra benchmarks and tree certificates alone are not a new physical mechanism. | ALREADY_DONE_OR_INCREMENTAL |

Strongest objections: (1) neither a robust neutrino-enforced observable nor a demonstrated physical acceptance accompanies the largest effect; targeted extremes and partial LFV cannot justify an experimentally viable topology. (2) prior work contains the cascade, mixing dependence, production studies and neutrino/flavor correlations; joining their ingredients at selected cards does not by itself establish a new result. A safe descriptive sentence is: “At two fixed tree-certified Zee potentials, stored neutrino-closing Yukawa designs produce widely different conditional charged-scalar daughter branching fractions.” It is not an EPJC central claim.

## Physics gates and validation

The unchanged contract remains authoritative: `global_acceptance=null`; coherent two-state B→Xsγ is diagnostic with uncalibrated uncertainty; μ→eγ has one-loop plus retained photon Barr–Zee subset only, with unbounded mixed-F charged-current/gauge terms; μ→3e lacks full penguin/box interference; μ→e conversion is not applied; absolute Higgs signal strengths/direct searches are incomplete. Full B/LFV/Higgs are UNKNOWN. Tree vacuum certificates do not imply loop/thermal stability. No exclusion, experimental allowedness, reach, 95% CL or detector yield is obtained; no separate single-state 670 GeV cut is imposed.

Validation performed: `python research/full_constraints/flavor_cascade/audit.py` checked each saved channel sum, branching normalization and rate multiplication, source presence/hashes, exact ID and scalar/receipt identities and null acceptance; 16 witness ledgers, 12 contrasts and 64+12 D14 rows passed. `python -m unittest research/full_constraints/flavor_cascade/test_audit.py -v` passed 3 arithmetic/null/count regression tests. These are internal arithmetic checks, not independent reproduction of the original matrix elements or experimental constraints. `git diff --check` is run before commit. The smallest next decision is whether to retire this as Paper 1's center on this evidence; no further calculation or scan is authorized by this result.
